disqualifier.note: Separate cluster from the already-recorded parallel_tool_calls/stream pair. stream and optional stream_options are OpenAI Chat Completions wire fields; makeRequest/makeStreamingRequest populate them together, which mirrors the provider rule that stream_options is only sent with stream:true, not a flattened local phase.

Separate cluster from the already-recorded finished/textEnded/textStarted span machine. finished is an emission latch; finishReason is independently copied from chunk finish_reason. Empty-choices wrap-up can finish without a reason, and a reason can arrive before usage completes the finish.

truncated is a result-cap fact; optional errors is independently attached when collectErrors/validate collected parse failures. Writers emit truncated-without-errors, errors-without-truncated, both, and neither.

Tolerant projection of openclaw gateway call health --json; ok and optional plugins are copied independently from the CLI envelope. projectGatewayHealth maps missing plugins to empty loaded/error counts and does not flatten ok into plugin presence.
Pinned secrets reload --json success envelope {ok, warningCount}. ok does not restate warningCount (always present); nonzero CLI exits take the Degraded tagged path instead of ok=false.

authenticated selects whether the escape-hatch request attaches the API key; optional body is the HTTP payload. Auth-off GET and auth-on POST with a body are both legal; authenticated does not restate body presence.
